about.summary: Only buy stocks in a strong, orderly uptrend (price above the 50-day, 50 above 150, 150 above 200-day averages, and beating the S&P 500), on a breakout to a 20-day high. Sell below the 50-day average or at a 7% loss.
about.style: Growth / momentum swing trading · weeks to months
about.why: Mark Minervini, a US Investing Championship winner, requires every stock he buys to pass his "Trend Template": stacked moving averages and strong relative strength, so you only trade leaders in stage-2 uptrends. He pairs it with strict losses of no more than about 7-8%, as O'Neil also teaches.
about.caveats: Simplified: the full template also requires the 200-day average to be rising, the price to be at least 30% above its 52-week low and within 25% of its high, and Minervini buys specific base patterns (VCP) backed by earnings growth. These rules can't check those. Works best in bull markets; sits out (or gets stopped out) in bear markets.
references: Minervini, M. (2013). Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard. McGraw-Hill.
Minervini, M. (2017). Think & Trade Like a Champion. Access Publishing Group.
O'Neil, W. J. (2009). How to Make Money in Stocks (4th ed.). McGraw-Hill.
